title: Knotted Fluffy French Turkey Ham Tarte Tatin
description: A savory and comforting French dish featuring turkey ham and double-rise-bread, perfect for a sick day. This shojin-friendly tarte tatin is made with simple ingredients and cooked to a fluffy perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and cook the diced turkey ham until browned.
Add the olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried thyme to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cubed double-rise-bread to the skillet and stir to coat with the turkey ham mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a slate tile or a tarte tatin dish.
Bake the tarte tatin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the turkey ham is cooked through.
Remove the tarte tatin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the knotted fluffy French turkey ham tarte tatin hot and enjoy.
